publication.body:
Closes #1150

- Q01-Q24: 24 PASS / 0 FAIL / 0 INCOMPLETE
- release-accepted cells: 12/12
- exact-aa2 Q08: candidate/pass/fail/error exits 0/0/1/2 with parity
- provider accounting: 126 posts, zero unknown outcomes or replay, conservative USD 64.744 under USD 70
- Q19: operator accepted 12 HTML + 12 PDF denominator; independent review verified all 24 hashes and 477 pages

The Linux Vector first execution-group failure remains retained adverse evidence; its compatible repeat satisfies Q06. This PR does not approve public deployment or launch. Native terminal closeout is deferred to the authorized asynchronous follow-up.
